extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x) = x^n where n is a real number, then f'(x) = nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The rate of change of a function, denoted f'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Real exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponent n that may be any real number, such as 1/2, -3, or π.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If c is constant and f is differentiable, then d/dx[cf(x)] = cf'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Sum Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f and g are differentiable, then d/dx[f(x) + g(x)] = f'(x) + g'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Difference Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f and g are differentiable, then d/dx[f(x) - g(x)] = f'(x) - g'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The property that a function has a derivative at the relevant point.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function formed from powers of x with constant coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function in which the variable appears in the exponent.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural exponential function e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The exponential function with base e; its derivative is itself.

extracted_concepts.name: General exponential function a^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponential function with base a; its derivative is a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Number e
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The unique number for which lim_{h→0} (e^h - 1)/h = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The logarithm with base e, appearing in d/dx(a^x) = a^x ln a.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A value approached by a function as its input approaches some point.

extracted_concepts.name: Position function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function s(t) giving the position of an object over time.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of position: v(t) = s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of velocity: a(t) = v'(t) = s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Second derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the derivative, written f''(x) or s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Cost function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function C(x) representing cost as a function of quantity.

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal cost
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The derivative of the cost function: MC = C'(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A quantity describing how one variable changes relative to another.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent line approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Uses the derivative to estimate function values near a known point.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The operation of finding a derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: Antidifferentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The inverse operation of differentiation.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and antidifferentiation/integration.
